environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with default configuration. No egress filtering, IMDSv1 enabled on task metadata endpoint. Service runs in a VPC with unrestricted outbound NAT. ALB forwards all traffic without inspection. No CSP headers added at the infrastructure level.

config.load_balancer: ALB with default listener rules, no WAF attached
config.network_policy: Allow all outbound from task ENI
config.csp_header: None configured at ALB or CDN layer
